GENERAL NOTES – TECHNICAL EXHIBIT 5

1. Facility data are extracted from the installation real property inventory (GFEBS) as of 30 September 2026. GSF is the gross square feet recorded as the primary unit of measure of the real property record. GSF is not the cleanable area; the Contractor shall determine cleanable area during the site visit.

2. Custodial frequency codes: 7X/WK – seven days per week; 5X/WK – Monday through Friday, excluding Federal holidays; 3X/WK – Monday, Wednesday and Friday; 2X/WK – Tuesday and Thursday; 1X/WK – once per week; 1X/MO – once per month. Task-level frequencies are in TE 7.

3. Facilities annotated “DEMO FY27 – EXCLUDE” are programmed for demolition before the start of the base period. They are listed for real property accountability only and shall not be priced.

4. Zone subtotals and the grand total are the sum of all listed facilities, including facilities annotated for demolition, and are provided for reference only.

5. Footnote markers (for example “1/”) printed after a facility name or a GSF value refer to the footnotes at the end of TE 5.

6. Facility numbers are shown as recorded in GFEBS: “P-”, “S-” and “T-” prefixes denote permanent, semi-permanent and temporary construction; a letter suffix (for example 00205A) denotes an annex with its own real property record; “R-” denotes range facilities.

7. Changes to the facility list after award are managed in accordance with PWS paragraph 1.6.4, Changes in Workload.
